<div class="card-body">
'''Y-wing Assault Squadron''' is a [[Light]] [[Starship]] ([[Squadron]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">Yウイング攻撃編隊</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊1つのロケーションにいる3機のYウイングと交換する（Yウイングはユーズド・デッキに行く）。パイロットか乗客を合計で3人加えられる。合計で能力値3の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Y-wing-Assault-Squadron-PSA-157709607.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">反乱軍の戦闘機は、機体が標的にさらされるのを最小限にとどめるため、編隊僚機の2機が先頭機を援護してくさび形の攻撃隊形を取る。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Y-wing assault formation.

'''Card text:'''
* Replaces 3 Y-wings at one location (the Y-wings go to the Used Pile). May add 3 pilots or passengers in total. Permanent pilots aboard provide total ability 3.

'''Lore:'''
Rebel fighters take a wedge attack formation, with two wingmen covering the lead, to keep the ships exposed to fire as little as possible.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Y-wing Assault Squadron]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
